items.title: 17.1 Alternating current aur is ki characteristics (khasiyatein) (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of topic 17.1 and Example 17.1 (PDF 85-88).

blocks.text: Alternating current (AC) woh current hai jo sine wave ki tarah upar neeche badalta rehta hai (sinusoidal). Ise waqt ke saath badalne wale sine ya cosine function se likh sakte hain. AC generator ki emf (voltage) yeh equation deti hai:

Yahan V waqt t par voltage (ya current) ki qeemat hai, Vₒ voltage ki sab se bari (maximum) qeemat hai aur ω alternating voltage ki angular frequency hai (Fig 17.1). Current ke liye bhi Eq. 17.1 isi tarah likhte hain:
Yahan I waqt t par current ki instantaneous (us lamhe wali) qeemat hai, Iₒ is ki maximum ya peak qeemat hai aur ω angular frequency hai.

blocks.title: Alternating current ya voltage
blocks.text: Jo current ya voltage baar baar ek hi tarah badle, woh alternating kehlata hai agar har cycle ek time period (T) ki ho aur us ke do bilkul ek jaise half cycles (aadhe hisse) hon: ek aadha positive aur doosra aadha negative.

Current mein har aadhe cycle ke baad current ki direction (simt) ulat jati hai; voltage mein har aadhe cycle ke baad polarity (kaunsa sira + aur kaunsa −) ulat jati hai. Doosri condition (shart) yeh hai ke amplitude (peak qeemat), yani positive aur negative dono taraf ki sab se bari qeemat, har cycle mein wahi rehti hai. Qeemat zero (crossover) points par sab se tezi se badalti hai aur peak par sab se aahista (Fig. 17.1).

blocks.alt: Voltage aur waqt ka green sine graph ka aik complete cycle, +Vo aur -Vo ke darmiyan; waqt ke axis par T/4, T/2, 3T/4 aur T, aur T par khari lakeer. Chotti par peak value likha hai. Oopar aur neeche double arrows 1 complete cycle aur time period dikhate hain.
blocks.caption: Figure 17.1: Alternating voltage ki waveform (kitab ki Figure 17.1 ke mutabiq original drawing).

blocks.text: Alternating quantities (miqdarein) ki kuch zaroori terms (istilahat):

items: Waveform: alternating quantity (jaise voltage) ko waqt ke saath graph par banayen to jo path (rasta, yani curve) banta hai, woh waveform hai (Fig. 17.1).
Cycle: positive aur negative qeematon ka ek mukammal set ek cycle hai. Fig. 17.1 alternating voltage ki ek cycle dikhati hai.
Time period (T): ek cycle poori hone mein jo waqt lagta hai, woh time period hai; ise seconds mein napte hain.
Frequency (f): ek second mein jitni cycles hoti hain, woh frequency hai. Is ki unit hertz (Hz) hai: 1 Hz = 1 cycle fi second, aur f = 1/T.

blocks.title: Kya aap jante hain?
blocks.text:
AC, DC se behtar kyun hai?
AC ko lambe faasle tak, yahan tak ke do shehron ke darmiyan, bhi baghair zyada energy waste (zaya) kiye bheja ja sakta hai. DC ko bohat lamba faasla bhejna mushkil hai; raste mein bijli ki power waste hoti hai.
AC waveform ki average (mean) qeemat

blocks.title: Average qeemat
blocks.text: AC waveform ki average qeemat cycle ke kisi khaas hisse mein tamam instantaneous qeematon ka arithmetic mean (hisabi average) hai.

Agar poori cycle (0 se 2π) ka average lein to jawab zero aata hai (Fig. 17.2), kyunke positive aadha cycle aur negative aadha cycle ek doosre ki mirror image (aaine jaisi ulti shakal) hain aur bilkul cancel ho jate hain. Yeh kisi kaam ka nahi. Is liye AC waveform ki average qeemat se aam taur par ek aadhe cycle (0 se π) ka average murad hota hai.

blocks.alt: Voltage (V) aur waqt (t) ka blue sine graph ka aik cycle, omega t 0 se 2 pi tak, pi/2, pi, 3 pi/2 aur 2 pi marked. Pehle half cycle ke neeche ka area shaded hai. Red dashed lakeerein peak Vo aur average qeemat (2/pi) Vo = 0.637 Vo dikhati hain.
blocks.caption: Figure 17.2: Alternating voltage ki average qeemat (kitab ki Figure 17.2 ke mutabiq original drawing).

blocks.text: Average qeemat rectification mein kaam aati hai. Jab AC signal rectifier (jaise power supply) se guzarta hai to output pulsating DC (jhatkon wala DC) hota hai. Bohat se kaamon mein isi pulsating DC ka average ahem hota hai. Full-wave rectified sine wave ke liye current aur voltage ki average qeematein:
Yahan Iₐᵥ aur Vₐᵥ alternating current aur voltage ki average qeematein hain, aur Iₒ aur Vₒ un ki maximum (peak) qeematein (Fig. 17.3). 0.637 asal mein 2/π hai.

blocks.alt: Peak Vo wali orange sine wave aur chhoti peak wali green sine wave aik saath. Dashed lakeerein positive peak Vo, Vrms = Vo/sqrt 2, Vavg = 0.637 Vo aur negative peak -Vo dikhati hain.
blocks.caption: Figure 17.3: Alternating voltage ki rms, average, peak aur p-p qeematein graph par (kitab ki Figure 17.3 ke mutabiq original drawing).

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab ki Fig. 17.3 mein average wali lakeer par bhi Vavg = Vₒ/√2 likha hai. Vₒ/√2 = 0.707 Vₒ to rms qeemat hai. Aadhe cycle ki average qeemat Vavg = 0.637 Vₒ hai, jo rms lakeer se thori neeche hoti hai; drawing mein yahi sahi qeematein di gayi hain.

Ek cycle mein AC waveform jis sab se oonchi qeemat tak pohanchti hai, woh peak qeemat hai: positive aadhe cycle ka sab se ooncha point ya negative aadhe cycle ka sab se neecha point (Figs. 17.1 aur 17.2). Voltage ke liye Vₒ aur current ke liye Iₒ likhte hain.

blocks.title: Brain teaser
blocks.text:
Carpet (qaleen) ke neeche AC wire hai ya nahi, kaise pata karein?
Non-contact voltage detector (pen tester) ya AC voltage setting wala multimeter istemal karein. Non-contact detector current ke electromagnetic field ko mehsoos kar ke roshni ya awaz se bata deta hai. Multimeter seedha voltage naap kar zyada theek naap deta hai.
Root-mean-square (rms) ya effective qeemat (current aur voltage):

rms qeematein alternating current ya voltage ko us ke barabar DC se compare (muqabla) karne ka aasaan tareeqa hain. rms qeemat woh DC current ya voltage hai jo utna hi heating effect (garmi) ya power paida kare jitni alternating current ya voltage karta hai. Alternating current ki rms qeemat ki definition (tareef):
Woh constant (mustaqil) current jo resistor mein utni hi power de jitni alternating current deta hai.
Alternating voltage ki rms qeemat ki definition:
Woh constant voltage jo resistor mein utni hi power de jitni alternating voltage deta hai.
Yani rms current Iᵣₘₛ = 0.707 Iₒ, jo peak current Iₒ ka taqreeban 70% hai.

blocks.title: Ghaur karein!
blocks.text:
High voltage bijli ki taaron ke paas chatakne aur sanasanane ki awaz kyun aati hai?
Is ki bari wajah corona discharge hai: strong (taqatwar) electric field ki wajah se conductor ke ird gird ki hawa ionise ho jati hai (hawa ke atoms charge wale ban jate hain). Is se halki chamak, radio mein shor aur sanasanane ya chatakne ki awaz paida hoti hai, khaas kar jab voltage hawa ki breakdown strength (bardasht ki had) se barh jaye.

blocks.title: Example 17.1
blocks.problem: Graph aur alternating current ki equation istemal kar ke t = 0.67 s par current ki qeemat nikalein. (Kitab sawal se pehle rms qeemat ki definition dobara deti hai: woh steady DC jo resistor mein AC jitni average power de.)
steps: AC ke liye: I = Iₒ sin (ωt) aur ω = 2π/T
Graph se: ek poori cycle ka waqt T = 0.10 s aur peak current Iₒ = 17 A
Angle = 2π × 0.67 s / 0.10 s = 2π × 6.7 = 42.1 radian. Yeh degree nahi, radian hai.
6.7 cycles ka matlab: 6 poori cycles (in se kuch nahi badalta) aur 0.7 cycle mazeed. 0.7 × 360° = 252°.
blocks.answer: I ≈ −16.2 A, yani 16.2 A ka current negative direction mein.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab angle 2 × 3.14 × 0.67/0.1 = 42.1 ko 42° (degree) samajh leti hai aur sin 42° = 0.917 likh kar I = 15.58 A deti hai. Lekin yeh angle radian mein hai, aur sin 42° bhi 0.917 nahi balke 0.669 hota hai. Sahi hal: 0.7 cycle = 252°, sin 252° = −0.951, I ≈ −16.2 A.

blocks.alt: Current (A) aur waqt (s) ka graph, 0 se 0.35 s tak, har 5 A aur 0.05 s par grid. Orange sine wave 0 se 17 A ki peak tak jati, -17 A tak girti aur 0.10 s ke period se repeat hoti hai.

blocks.title: Kya aap jante hain?
blocks.text:
Kaise pata karein ke current alternating hai?
Step 1: current ki direction maloom karein.
Step 2: dekhein ke direction badalti hai ya wahi rehti hai.
Step 3: agar direction baar baar ulat'ti hai to current alternating (AC) hai; agar current hamesha ek hi taraf behta hai to direct current (DC) hai.

blocks.prompt: Pakistan mein mains voltage 50 Hz par 220 V rms hai. Is ki peak qeemat, peak-to-peak qeemat aur period kya hain?

blocks.text: Short summary (mukhtasar khulasa)

items: V = Vₒ sin ωt = Vₒ sin (2πft); f = 1/T.
Poori cycle ka average zero; aadhe cycle ka average 0.637 × peak.
rms = peak/√2 = 0.707 × peak: utni hi garmi jitni itna DC deta hai.
